description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures on certain hardware, specifically supporting boards like technexion, imx7d-pico-pi. It defines functions to check image metadata, perform upgrades, copy configurations, and pre-upgrade steps, mainly for the imx7d-pico-pi board.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata check for specific boards, particularly technexion, imx7d-pico-pi.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current board supports the sysupgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process on the specified board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration for the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps for the specific board.
